App.Title: Desktop Drawer
App.Subtitle: A paged desktop
Empty.ClearText: Files and folders you add will appear here.
Empty.PageText: Try another page or adjust the icon size.
Sort.Name: Name

Settings.Title: Settings
Layout.Title: Desktop controls
Layout.Description: Move the header, pager, summary, hint and group badge, and drag a corner grip to resize them.
Layout.ResetToast: Layout reset to the default positions and sizes.
Appearance.IconSizeDesc: Choose how large desktop items appear. Smaller tiles fit more items on each page.
Appearance.AutoIconToast: Icon size follows the density preset.
Appearance.TextSizeDesc: Scales headings, labels, buttons and the desktop icon names.
Appearance.ColorsDesc: Every colour in the overlay is editable. Pick one to open the RGB picker.
Appearance.ResetColorsToast: All colors reset to the default look.
Appearance.WallpaperDimDesc: Darkens the wallpaper behind the icons. 0% keeps it untouched.
Grid.FitDesc: Let the app choose how many columns and rows fit.
Sorting.FoldersFirstDesc: Keep folders above files when sorting.
Sorting.ShowHiddenDesc: Include hidden and system items from the desktop.
Behavior.AlwaysShowDesc: Keep the header and the page bar visible instead of fading them out.
Behavior.CloseToTrayDesc: Keep Desktop Drawer running when the window is closed.
Behavior.StartWithWindowsDesc: Open Desktop Drawer automatically after sign-in.
Windows.HideNowDesc: Temporarily hide the icons on the Windows desktop while you use Desktop Drawer.
Windows.HideOnLaunchDesc: Automatically hide the Windows icons whenever Desktop Drawer starts.
Windows.RestoreNote: Desktop icon visibility is restored when Desktop Drawer exits.
About.Text: Your desktop files, spread across calm, page-sized views. Files stay exactly where they are.
LayoutToolbar.Title: Layout editor
LayoutToolbar.Desc: Drag to move. Use the edge and corner grips to resize.
ColorPicker.Title: Choose a color

ColorToken.SurfaceHint: Hover cards, fields and pressed controls.
ColorToken.PanelHint: Settings, menus, toasts, the pager and badges.
ColorToken.ShadeHint: Dimming behind the overlay and the wallpaper.
